role: Previously consumed DFL J03WOH provider-flag diagnostic; no new model selection or challenge score.
source: DFL and Bassek et al. (2025), CC BY 4.0, https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.28196177

exit_gate_diagnosis.role: Diagnostic only; relaxing the depth gate based on this consumed provider match would not be an independent selection.

development_shallow_dwell_probe.policy: One second of continuously observed shallow outside-ball positions after an outward crossing, then an observed inside return; applied only as an exploratory opt-in comparison to the selected exit-only model.
development_shallow_dwell_probe.decision: No objective gain; remove the trial implementation and stop before Games 2/3, DFL candidate scoring or challenge input. This negative exploratory probe was not frozen as a release candidate.

interpretation: The missing 196 live spells cannot be attributed solely to stoppages: 301 provider live-team switches versus 178 predicted direct switches, while 100 provider live spells start after dead. DFL freezes ball positions through dead intervals, so stationary-ball and shallow-border shortcuts cannot be assumed to transfer to other providers. Provider flags are not independently reviewed physical contacts; no default or selected CSV changed.
